req.title: Health responds under load-balancer probe path
req.statement: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.
triggers: health responds under load-balancer probe path

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-039 requires GET /health/ to return HTTP 2xx with sub-second latency and no external dependencies. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal GET /health/ returns exactly 200; (2) negative NEG — wrong method POST /health/ returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — latency must be strictly < 1000 ms (testing the sub-second threshold); (4) DT — verifying response body content is non-empty/valid JSON; (5) NEG — wrong path GET /health (no trailing slash) returns 404 or redirect, not 200 from the health route. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

tests.executable:
import time
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_latency_sub_second():
    client = TestClient(app)
    start = time.monotonic()
    response = client.get('/health/')
    elapsed_ms = (time.monotonic() - start) * 1000
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert elapsed_ms < 1000, f'Latency {elapsed_ms:.1f}ms exceeded 1000ms threshold'

test_health_latency_sub_second()

def test_health_response_body_is_valid_json():

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_wrong_path_no_trailing_slash_returns_4xx():
    client = TestClient(app, follow_redirects=False)
    response = client.get('/health')
    assert response.status_code != 200
    assert response.status_code in (307, 404, 308)

test_health_wrong_path_no_trailing_slash_returns_4xx()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_repeated_calls_all_return_200():
    client = TestClient(app)
    for i in range(10):
        response = client.get('/health/')
        assert response.status_code == 200, f'Call {i} returned {response.status_code}'

test_health_repeated_calls_all_return_200()
